results.name: direct calls retain both source locations; declaration/comment/string/address are not calls
same-named static definitions retain separate file identities, without resolving references
both preprocessor branches remain visible without build flags
function-pointer calls are syntax calls; a separate resolver is required
macro invocation is parsed but its body is not expanded into a function call
function-pointer table and initializer are identifiable as declaration syntax
Korean and emoji before a multiline call preserve JavaScript text offsets
local variable shadowing is retained in syntax; name-only matching would be unsafe

limitations: Syntax extraction only; no project-wide resolver was implemented.
No VS Code extension or UI was executed.
No real project performance or cross-platform validation.
